# dsh-drive-backup
rclone backup tooling for DeepSeek Harness.

`dsh-drive-backup` gives your DSH agent a small, explicit set of backup tools on
top of rclone: see

what is configured, check whether the
remote copy is current, verify it, and run a transfer — the la

st one only with
your approval.

Targets are an allow-list from config, commands are argv arrays (never shell
strings), a dry run is
free, and every real transfer leaves one audit line.
## Tools
| Tool | Kind | What it does |
| `backup_targets` | read-only | Lists configured targets: local path, rclone destination, mode, tim

eout, excludes. |
| `backup_status` | read-only | Local size, remote size and the newest remote file

s for one target or all of them. |
| `backup_verify` | read-only | `rclone check` between the local

path and the remote copy; reports matches, differences and samples. |
| `backup_transfer` | approved
| Runs `rclone copy`/`sync` for one target. `dryRun: true` needs no approval; a real transfer asks
`rclone copy`/`sync` for one target. `dryRun: true` needs no approval; a real transfer asks first. |
## Modes

- **`copy`** (default) — uploads new and changed files, **never deletes** remote
files. Safe for tim

estamped backups.
- **`sync`** — mirrors the local path; files missing locally are **deleted**
remot
ely. Opt in per target.

`rclone` must already be configured for the remote (`rclone config`); this plugin
never touches rclo
ne's config file and never reads credentials.
## Configuration
| Key | Default | Meaning |

| `remote` | `grive` | rclone remote name. |
| `rclone` | `rclone` | rclone executable name or absol

ute path. |
| `targets[].id` | — | Stable id used by the tools (`[a-z0-9_-]`). |
| `targets[].label`

| `''` | Human label; the model may use it instead of the id. |
| `targets[].local` | — | Absolute

local file or directory. |
| `targets[].remotePath` | — | Path below the remote root, relative, no `

..`. |
| `targets[].mode` | `copy` | `copy` or `sync`. |
| `targets[].excludes` | `[]` | rclone excl

ude patterns. |
| `targets[].transfers` | `4` | Parallel transfers. |
| `targets[].timeoutMs` | `600

000` | Wall-clock limit for this target. |
| `verify.sizeOnly` | `true` | Compare sizes only; `false

` compares hashes (slow). |
| `safety.readOnly` | `false` | When true, `backup_transfer` refuses; in

spection still works. |
| `safety.requireApproval` | `true` | Real transfers ask the host first. |
|

`safety.timeoutMs` | `120000` | Default command timeout. |
| `safety.maxOutputBytes` | `65536` | Ou

tput cap per call. |
| `audit.file` | `<DSH_HOME>/logs/drive-backup-audit.log` | Audit file. |
## Safety model

- **Allow-list.** Only configured targets exist; an unknown id is rejected with
the configured list,

and the model is told not to guess names.
- **argv only.** `rclone` runs as executable plus argumen

t array; target paths
never become shell syntax, and remote paths are validated (relative, no `..`).

- **Dry run first.** `backup_transfer` with `dryRun: true` lists what would move and
needs no appro

val.
- **Fail-closed approval.** A real transfer runs only on `allowed-once`; a
missing or throwing

approval answerer means nothing happens.
- **Bounded.** Each transfer has a timeout and an output ca

p.
- **Audited.** One JSON line per attempt:
`{"ts":"…","tool":"backup_transfer","target":"openvikin
g","mode":"copy","outcome":"executed",…}`.
